 Sanjay Vashisth, J. (Oral)

1.  In the present habeas corpus petition, on 04.05.2023 following order was passed:
"1. Prayer in this petition, filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is for issuance of a writ in the nature of habeas corpus and for appointment of a Warrant Officer.
2.

Learned counsel contends that the alleged detenues, namely, 1. Lovepreet Singh,
aged 27 years, 2. Jatinder Kaur, aged 54 years & 3. Harjot Singh, who are related as son, wife and wife's nephew respectively of the petitioner,
has been illegally detained by respondent No. 3-Station House Officer, Police Station, Ramngar, District Karnal and respondents No.4- Incharge, CIA-2 Staff, New Police Lines, Karnal, District Karnal.

In the meantime, Registry is directed to appoint a Warrant Officer, on payment of usual charges, who will visit the place(s) of alleged detention of detenues and if found in illegal detention, then to get them released immediately after recording their statement.
5. The Warrant Officer shall submit his detailed report in that regard on or before the date fixed by this Court."

2. Relevant para of the report is reproduced hereinbelow :

"In compliance of the orders dated 04.05.2023 passed by the Hon'ble High Court, I alongwith the petitioner of the alleged detenues and his brother reached Police Station, CIA-2 Staff, New Police Lines, Karnal District Karnal at 10.50 P.M. on 04.05.2023, KAVITA NAIN detenue Lovepreet Singh and Jatinder Kaur were standing outside 2023.05.22 18:01 I attest to the accuracy and the said Police Station.
At 10.54 P.M., I alongwih the petitioner and integrity of this document order/judgment 2023:PHHC:074444 detenue Lovepreet Singh, Jatinder Kaur and his brother entered into the Police Station.

SHO Mohan Lal, MHC Mohan Lal,
Constable Mohit, Head Constable Satinder and other Police Officials were present in the said Police Station.
I disclosed my identity and purpose of visit to them.
Entry in this regard was made in the D.D. Register.

D.D. No.11 dated 04.05.2023 is enclosed herewith as Annexure "A"
I asked SHO Mohan Lal whether detenues- Lovepreet Singh, Jatinder Kaur and Harjot Singh are in illegal custody of Respondent No.3 and 4.

He denied the allegation made by the petitioner and told that these detenues were detained by the Police in Case FIR No. 0153 dated 01.06.2021 Police Station Ram Nagar, Karnal under Section 406,420 and 34 IPC.
Detenue Lovepreet Singh and Jatinder kaur had left the Police Station at 4.00 P.M. after giving their statements on 04.05.2023
.Detenue
Harjot Singh was required in the said FIR for further investigation.
SHO Mohan Lal handed over the Arrest Memo of the said detenue which was prepared by the Police Station Ramangar (Respondent No.3) alongwith D.D.R.No. 10 dated 04.5.02023.

Copies of the FIR No. 153 dated 01.06.2021,Arrest Memo alongwith DDR are enclosed herewith as Annexure "B" "C" and "D"
respectively.

During the search operation, the said SHO told me that a Criminal Writ Petition No. 7395 of 2022 has been filed by one Lakhwinder Singh, father of the victim namely Vikramjit Singh for issuance of direction to the official respondents for making inquiry to locate whereabouts of his son, who on 27.11.2020, boarded a flight from Delhi to Dubai and then on 02.12.2020 to Turkey through travel agent.

Thereafter, he went missing and the said petitioner has already got registered an FIR No. 153 dated 01.06.2021 under Section 320, 406, 420, 384 and 34 of IPC and Section 24 of Immigration Act at Police Station Ram Nagar District Karnal.
